items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Then after Eddie Gilmore got out, we had taken Simon, Simon Moreira. He played with us a long time.

ctx.x: Buddy Manaday. That's before he went with Buddy Petit, huh?
Yeah. Buddy Manaday and Lil T-Boy on the bass. A fella that called T-Boy. Eddie Gilmore?
Yeah, that's right. That was our original band.
